answer: A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The violet counter is kept in quill and echo shows each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4476 identities would post 4485 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
